claims: Apple CarPlay Ultra requires iOS 18.5 or newer.
Apple CarPlay Ultra requires iPhone 12 or later.
Apple CarPlay Ultra offers customizable dashboard gauges.
Apple CarPlay Ultra offers Apple Maps integration in the driver display.
Apple CarPlay Ultra is currently available on 2025 Aston Martin models.
Apple CarPlay Ultra debuted on the 2025 Aston Martin DBX707.
Select 2024–2025 Aston Martin models (DB12, Vantage) can be updated to include Apple CarPlay Ultra.
Apple CarPlay Ultra takes over the central display.
Apple CarPlay Ultra takes over the driver instrument cluster.
Apple CarPlay Ultra's instrument cluster integration features analog-style dials.
Apple CarPlay Ultra's instrument cluster integration features full-width maps.
Apple CarPlay Ultra's instrument cluster integration features customizable widgets (weather, calendar) within the gauge cluster.
Apple CarPlay Ultra allows users to adjust climate control (temperature, fan speed, seat heating) without leaving the CarPlay interface.
Apple CarPlay Ultra allows users to adjust audio settings (FM/SiriusXM) without leaving the CarPlay interface.
Apple CarPlay Ultra displays live metrics like tire pressure, engine temperature, and fuel levels directly on the instrument display.
Apple CarPlay Ultra provides access to car settings like drive modes, lighting, and parking sensors.
Drivers can select multiple skins, including 80s-style layouts and minimalist designs, for Apple CarPlay Ultra.
Some reviews have noted occasional lag in the Apple CarPlay Ultra interface or with volume control.
Apple CarPlay Ultra includes a privacy mode to manage data sharing.
Apple CarPlay Ultra has future support from Hyundai, Kia, and Porsche.
Apple CarPlay Ultra support is planned for future models from Hyundai, Kia, and Genesis.
